killedBy: dropMine honours a tank's own mineCap over the roster's, and only when one is stamped (issue #358)
why: The mine-axis twin of shell-cap-ignores-the-tanks-own-budget: reads the roster's capacity and ignores the tank's own, so issue #358's arm zeroes Teal on paper while it keeps laying two mines (the arm's Brown, Olive and Green zeroes are moot here: those kinds hold no MINE_LAYER and lay none either way). Shipped behaviour is identical either way (no tank carries a cap without the flag), so only a fixture that stamps one can tell -- which is also why mines.test.ts's mkTank has to pass `mineCap` through: measured while landing this, deleting that one line reproduces this exact failure, because the fixture then builds a tank that silently ignores the cap it claims.
